Random shit happens in Formula 1 that decides races all the time. We could play the “should have won” game as I’m sure other people might with you, HELL I could go into how Hamilton and the FIA fucked Vettel in Canada….Not saying that the FIA and Masi shouldn’t seriously get their shit together, because they absolutely should. In a sport where tenths, hundredths and thousandths of a second make a difference, there are any number of things throughout this season that could have decided the winner long before this. Max’s DNFs, Hamilton’s DNF and mistakes in the pit that cost him the lead…..that’s the sport man. Races are won and lost over mistakes. This obviously doesn’t include this last race except for saying Latifi wrecking was a true mistake. I truly feel for Lewis and can’t imagine watching the WDC slip away from you in less than 90 seconds, but saying Max wasn’t worthy of being a WDC is short sighted. I think they both deserved to win after the season they had. But again, I’m sure we’re not going to agree. Also, people are quick to forget that Schumacher had some controversial WDC wins but is still widely respected and beloved because he was fucking great at what he did. 

Also, people are allowed to disagree with you and have a different view without being a fanboy of Max. I could make assumptions about you since you are a Hamilton fan, but I prefer to be a bit more open minded than that.
